newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Fipe inflation 0.10 pct in Sept 8-Oct 7.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Fipe inflation 0.10 pct in Sept 8-Oct 7.

text.p: Brazil's inflation as measured by the Economic Research Institute (Fipe) was 0.10 percent in the Sept 8-Oct 7 period, up an edge from 0.07 in the previous four-week period , a Fipe official said.
Juarez Rizzieri, the president of Fipe, said a slowdown in the rate of decline in food and clothing prompted a slight increase in the price index, which measures prices in the Sao Paulo area.
Food prices fell 0.16 percent while clothing declined 0.65 percent. The period also saw a slight decline in education costs.
Rizzieri estimated October inflation could be between 0.20 and 0.40 percent if the present trend continues in clothing and food prices.
He released the following breakdown of the weighted Fipe inflation index for the four-week period ended Oct 7:
-Personal expenses: 0.19 pct rise in the period
-Health care: 0.75 pct rise in the period
The Fipe index is calculated by the University of Sao Paulo, which releases inflation figures at weekly intervals.
